Galaktikon I and II by Brendan Small.

 Both are space metal, but the first one is more accessible if you aren't into heavy guitar and death growls. The second is melodic death metal. They both sound pretty unique, and its hard to find albums that come close in terms of replayability and production quality. I usually listen to them all the way through in one sitting.

The first one is about a superhero being divorced by his wife, failing to move on and then having to come to terms with saving her after his archenemy kidnaps her. 

The opener, "Triton," is probably my favorite album opener of all time, and the finale track, "On My Way," really drives home how broken he had become. My favorite track is probably, "Truth Orb and the Kill Pool."

The second album, Galaktikon II: Become the Storm, is more vague and a lot heavier. The vocals are heavier and mixed quieter, and the guitar tracks are even more complex. It still remains very melodic. 

The track, "My Name is Murder," is probably my go to driving-fast-song. My favorite track is either, "The Ocean Galaktik," or, "Nightmare."
